programmeDescription: The Master of Energy is a limited entry programme with only 40 students accepted into the programme each year. Applications are reviewed at the same time by the programme selection committee. The application will be ranked based on your academic achievement in relevant tertiary study, and a qualitative assessment of your work experience to date.
